description: Source file defining the base class 'HTTP_WebDAV_Server' which provides a virtual framework for implementing WebDAV servers in PHP. It includes method stubs for handling HTTP requests such as GET, PUT, PROPFIND, LOCK, UNLOCK, and others, along with helper functions for lock token management, header parsing, and response generation.

classes.name: HTTP_WebDAV_Server
classes.description: A base class providing default implementations and framework for a WebDAV server, to be extended with specific resource handling and authentication logic.

methods.name: ServeRequest
methods.description: Dispatches incoming HTTP request to appropriate method handler based on detected request method.

methods.name: http_OPTIONS
methods.description: Handles OPTIONS requests by returning allowed methods and DAV compliance level.

methods.name: http_PROPFIND
methods.description: Handles PROPFIND requests, calling user-defined handler to retrieve properties.

methods.name: http_PROPPATCH
methods.description: Handles PROPPATCH requests to modify resource properties.

methods.name: http_MKCOL
methods.description: Handles MKCOL requests to create collections.

methods.name: http_GET
methods.description: Handles GET requests, serving resource content with support for byte-range requests.

methods.name: http_HEAD
methods.description: Handles HEAD requests, returning status without body.

methods.name: http_PUT
methods.description: Handles PUT requests, allowing resource upload or modification.

methods.name: http_DELETE
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete resources.

methods.name: http_COPY
methods.description: Handles COPY requests to duplicate resources.

methods.name: http_MOVE
methods.description: Handles MOVE requests to move or rename resources.

methods.name: http_LOCK
methods.description: Handles LOCK requests to lock resources.

methods.name: http_UNLOCK
methods.description: Handles UNLOCK requests to release resource locks.

methods.name: _copymove
methods.description: Helper function to perform copy or move operations based on parameter.

methods.name: _allow
methods.description: Returns a list of allowed HTTP methods supported by the resource.

methods.name: mkprop
methods.description: Helper to create property array objects for responses.

methods.name: _check_auth
methods.description: Checks authentication by calling user-defined methods if available.

methods.name: _new_uuid
methods.description: Generates a UUID, using uuid_create() if available or fallback method.

methods.name: _new_locktoken
methods.description: Creates a new lock token UUID for LOCK responses.

methods.name: _if_header_parser
methods.description: Parses the 'If:' header into resource URIs and conditions.

methods.name: _check_uri_condition
methods.description: Stub for checking a condition on a URI from the 'If:' header; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: _check_lock_status
methods.description: Checks if the specified resource is locked, using user-defined method checkLock if available.

methods.name: lockdiscovery
methods.description: Creates a lockdiscovery XML fragment for a resource based on checklock() info.

methods.name: http_status
methods.description: Sets HTTP status code and message, reflecting the result of request handling.

methods.name: _urlencode
methods.description: Minimal URL encoding for special characters.

methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded string.

methods.description: Ensures property values are encoded in UTF-8.
